# r/DetroitPistons (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Detroit Pistons stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Detroit Pistons in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #7 Cade Cunningham 70.3
- #14 Jalen Duren 65.9
- #42 Ausar Thompson 58.8
- #100 Isaiah Joe 52.2
- #103 Duncan Robinson 52.0
- #117 Paul Reed 50.3
- #145 John Collins 47.6
- #198 Javonte Green 44.3

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
